key_insight: Variational optimization can compensate for hardware imperfections in noisy polarization-qubit experiments, with automated polarization compensation comparable to conventional methods.
engineering_relevance: The approach offers a route to automated calibration of imperfect optical quantum-network hardware.
method: Parameterize quantum-network protocols for variational optimization.
Optimize simple prepare-and-measure protocols on an optical testbed.
Compare gradient-estimation methods and analyze hardware imperfections and dark counts.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a proof-of-principle optical demonstration with polarization-compensation performance comparable to conventional methods, but provides no numerical benchmarks.
watch_item: Performance remains sensitive to hardware imperfections and dark counts, and deployment on fiber-network nodes is proposed rather than demonstrated.
paper_title: Variational Quantum Optimization of Noisy Polarization Qubit Experiments
